title: Egyptian priests levitating blocks with sound

tellings.quote: of ancient Egyptian Traditions that speak of the priests levitating these large blocks and this is accompanied by sound

plain: Graham Hancock, a writer known for arguing that a lost ancient civilisation once existed, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that there are ancient Egyptian traditions describing priests who made large stone blocks float in the air. He says these stories have the lifting happen along with sound. If true, it would mean the builders of monuments like the Great Pyramid had a way of moving stone that we no longer know about.
